Apocalypse Now!
Come back soooooooon!

Surely you aren't thinking of WALKING back?
Do you intend to make me march for no purpose?
Look for that #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF!

Stay here.

Well done, Senpai.
How did you like the enemy marathon of hell?
Did you suffer?
…what did she say?
BB's voyeurism.
BB's remark.

……………uh, Senpai?
Why am I here?
I called you here.
…you don't remember?
Let my Servant reply.

Eh? You called me over, Senpai?
O-oh. In that case… I guess I had no choice
but to drop what I was doing…
What do I do with these two?

I'm glad…
I still have some leeway…

………do you mind quitting with that
"breast size is related to IQ" argument?
I WILL sue.
Hi-yah!
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF took insane damage!

Hmm. While you did boot it up, this level of
modding is easy even for me. …do you think
if you work, you lose?

I bothered to show up this time because it
seems like she's slacking off.
Yes, that must be it.
#C236196003BB#CDEF is convinced by her own words.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's #C000246204invincibility skill#CDEF?
Um… she shouldn't have any abilities
like that…
Her reply was unexpected.
#C236196003BB#CDEF leaves, looking a bit listless.

#C000246204#TITM0001#CDEF.

After making a shortcut to the old school from
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF, please return to base.

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that
you return for the moment to take a rest.
I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,
but I should #C000246204return to the old school#CDEF to
briefly speak with #C236196003Kiara#CDEF.

I obtained the first #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Let's briefly return to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and sort
out the situation.

First thing to do is activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
That'll help move our search along.

We took more damage from our fight with #C236196003Lancer#CDEF
than I expected. Now would be a good time to head
back to the old school.
Luckily, there's a #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF near us.

What's wrong, Praetor?
Let's #C000246204continue onward#CDEF!

Don't worry. I'll protect you, Darling.
So, continue on #C000246204ahead#CDEF.

Surely you're not telling me that you're
frightened? Even you understand that stopping
here is impermissible, yes?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

We finally reach the item folder.
There's no doubt about it―inside… *it* awaits us.
Let's take it and scram before #C236196003BB#CDEF gets here.

Hee hee hee… I knew spending a little less
on the other Labyrinths to fortify this
one was the right call.

I won't tolerate villains who corrupt the
academy's public morals. You need to repent so
you don't ever put off other #[girls][students]# again.

This isn't a 3D projection like before.
Waiting in front of the item folder was #C236196003BB#CDEF.
#C236196003BB#CDEF controls the majority of the #C000246204Far Side of the Moon#CDEF.

#C236196003BB#CDEF may be in the middle of invading the Core,
but she can probably instantly #RUBS    jump #RUBEteleport#REND anywhere,
with the exception of the old school building, a neutral-zone.
…this was an unwinnable race from the get-go.

The moment we fell for the bait,
we were destined to be cornered by #C236196003BB#CDEF…

…no, it's too soon to give up, #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND.
Do you notice anything off about how
#C236196003BB#CDEF is acting?

Wait. Save the chit-chat for another time.
Something's off about how #C236196003BB#CDEF is acting.
I don't want to believe it, but she's―――

…Darling, please be silent.
#C236196003Dark Sakura#CDEF isn't acting hostile. The black
aura she's giving off is clearly weak.

No. Be silent for a moment, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF.
I didn't like her choice of words just now.
Could this woman―――

…?
I do as #C236196003#SVT#CDEF suggests and keep quiet for the time being.

I didn't want to say something wrong and make
things tense like back when she was broadcasting footage.

#C236196003BB#CDEF is becoming noticeably peppier.
Maybe she's taking delight in our nervousness.

Did you tire yourself out so much you can't
even speak? Good, good. The trap I worked so
hard to design was worth the trouble!

If I had known, I would've set up a camera in
the Labyrinth. I could've watched my fill of
you and #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's hijinks.

I heard #C236196003Rin#CDEF murmuring over the comms.
She's surprised over:

Yeah, right on the money, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.
Setting a camera up in the Labyrinth is
both excessive and an invasion of privacy…

I feel the same way. WE only get to
observe #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF with the
camera placed behind #[him][her]#.

Um… that's not the point we should
be focusing on…
Rather, it's that she contradicted herself.

That's right.
#C236196003BB#CDEF contradicted herself with that remark.

In the closing of her self-proclaimed "recorded movie,"
#C236196003BB#CDEF definitely said that she "was constantly watching."

Yet, judging by what she just said now,
#C236196003BB#CDEF isn't watching this Labyrinth.

? What's the matter? Ah. Are you surprised
that I stopped drilling towards the Core
to bother coming all the way here?

Hee hee. I'm sure it was a miscalculation.
How inefficient can I be, right?
An AI would never do something so pointless…

I left #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF to take care of things
while I rush to the Core.
I didn't expect to see Senpai anymore…

#C236196003BB#CDEF tilts her head, puzzled, and questions me.
…I can't believe this, but it seems like she's serious.
My response is―

What!? A-are you dumb!?
As if I want to be bullied by myself! This
little service was a one-time-only thing!

I came all on my own?
You say I've been watching you for a
while now, Senpai?

Don't give me that nonsense. I don't recall
that. I'll find out soon enough, once I check
my #RUBS     backlog #RUBEpast records#REND―――
――――#ROFS0003#RUBS    Backlogs#RUBEPast records#REND have been overwritten…

…h-hmph. You got lucky this time, Senpai. It's
a silly lie, but since I have no proof, I'll let
it go. I'll forgive you just this once.
I try letting #C236196003#SVT#CDEF reply.

I'm not sure that I can succeed at fooling her,
but a quick witted retort from #C236196003#SVT#CDEF should do the trick!

Why wouldn't you be here? You've long been
peeping on my Praetor. Now finally, unable to
bear it, you've come to commit a criminal act.

You actions may be incorrigible, but we can work
it out. Hand over the peep-footage you took.
I'll pretend this never was, really… really!

T-that's―――b-but, repeating yourself
twice makes it sound like twice the lie.
Is your vitriol honest, #C236196003Saber#CDEF?

…this isn't good.
I won't be able to #RUBStsukkomi#RUBEquip#REND in time.

If #C236196003Saber#CDEF's remarks are subpar,
then #C236196003BB#CDEF's decision-making skills are also subpar.

We only came here to look for items. We have no
way of knowing about your situation. You can
probably chalk this up to your usual whim.

T-that must be it! I deliberately made some
meaningless choice, practicing some of that
fluctuation humans have! Definitely!

Yes… I've come so far.
As if I would break halfway.
I won't allow that…

I suppose I must. You have amnesia at your age?
Oh, does all your nutrition go straight to your
chest? Blood not flowing to your brain?

She has a point.
It's not nice to attack people based on
their physical characteristics.
Besides, if we're talking about bust size, #C236196003Caster#CDEF is…

Back to the topic. You came here all on your
own―out of jealousy for the joint endeavors
of love that Darling and I share.

…I don't recall that being the case,
but if I were to see something like that,
I certainly would fly into a rage.

"Why," you ask? Seeing #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF and I fight
together―the extreme beauty of it―triggered
the sadist within you.

And unable to control yourself, you abandoned
your position as a boss and came running here.
While your capture of the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF was nigh.

Eh… I-is that so? I don't like how you said it,
but it is true that you always speak accurately.
If you say so, #C236196003Gilgamy#CDEF…

But if that were the case, I would expect myself
to have left a #C236196003BB#CDEF-memo in my pitter-patter
animal training notebook…

"It hurts," or "this is harsh."
Nothing like that is written in there…
I-in any case, that's enough of that topic!

I did not foresee these circumstances,
but Senpai is right here before me.
As the #RUBS  Game Master#RUBEGM#REND, I won't make things easy!

I prepared an exclusive Sakura-Enemy.
Please struggle hard, and if not,
then please suffer defeat.

Hee hee. You've gotten stronger, and rightly so.
If you weren't, this wouldn't be worth my
time as the #RUBS  Game Master#RUBEGM#REND.

…hmph. You patronize us by entrusting
the battle to a subordinate. Know this:
your pride will one day be your undoing.

…I don't mind messing around,
but you're not going to get your own
hands dirty?

I'm disappointed that you left this fight to a
minion after spurring us on so. Have you run out
of those illegal actions you're so good at?

I'm just the brains here. If an insect were in
my workplace, I would smack it down, no mercy.
But, this area is under #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's control.

It looks like she really doesn't remember that
previous broadcast.

Wait a second, try to lead her into telling
us something! As a #RUBS  Game Master#RUBEGM#REND, #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's
invincibility must be against the rules!

#C236196003Rin#CDEF does it again.
She's on top of things.

If #C236196003BB#CDEF is calling herself "Game Master,"
then her pride is reliant on maintaining a
balanced playing field.

If we complain to her about #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF's
invincibility skill, she may give us some hint on what to do.

#C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF has no invincibility skill?
Then how does one explain the absurd phenomenon
where "attacks hit her but have no effect"?

………that's how it is. Well, whatever.
#C236196003Rin#CDEF is a perceptive one, she should be able to
realize what the deal is just from my reply.

This is something interesting I didn't
expect to hear. I'll thank you by letting
you go this time.

I'm going back to the Core's barrier.
I'm so close to seizing the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF. I don't
have time to play with my dummy Senpai.

When I see #C236196003BB#CDEF acting like that… maybe it's
because she has the same face #C236196003Sakura#CDEF does:
for a moment, I actually felt concerned for her health.

What's wrong?
The item you wanted so badly is right there.

Prompted by #C236196003Rin#CDEF, I shake off the strange,
troubling feeling I have.

This definitely isn't the time to be concerned about #C236196003BB#CDEF,
the supreme leader of our enemies.
